title: Plan Operations
not_for: A feature roadmap or replacing jurisdiction-specific professional advice.
input_gate: Define delivery units, a planning period, available capacity, owners, costs, suppliers, and failure contingencies before promising service levels.

dependencies.failure_trigger: Approved export cannot be obtained before the billing cycle
dependencies.fallback: Reduce pilot scope; do not send unverified invoices

example_note: Twenty batches at half an hour require ten hours; eight available hours leave a two-hour gap. The plan must reduce demand, add capacity, or change the promise before launch.
failure_case: Incorrect capacity or labor-cost arithmetic, unowned dependencies, or a missing fallback fails completion.
